func run(items: [(Value?, Int)]) async throws {
 var value: Value? = nil
 var key = 0
 for item in items {
  (value, key) = item
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
  if value == nil { value = try await read(key) }
 }
}
func once(items: [(Int, Int)]) async throws {
 var value: Value? = nil
 for item in items {
  (key, other) = item
  if value == nil { value = try await read() }
 }
}
